// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// Deliberately placed in the ONE module permitted to mutate anything, so that
// OPS-MUTATION-MODULE cannot fire and the classification itself is what refuses
// it. Written at src/lib/ops/reads.ts this fixture would pass for the wrong
// reason and prove nothing about PLATFORM_CONTENT being read-only.
// The near miss the shared library invites: an operator screen that publishes.
// SharedActivity is PLATFORM_CONTENT, which is read-only on purpose. Publishing
// is scripts/ops/publish-shared-activities.mjs, in the repository, reviewable in
// a pull request and impossible to fat-finger in production. A write from here
// is how a curated library quietly becomes user-generated content.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function publishActivity(slug, title) {
  return db.sharedActivity.create({ data: { slug, title, published: true } });
}
